answer: The strongest defense is attestation weight counting only peers outside your kinship cluster: a thread of mutual self-attestations inside one ring earns zero, while vouches from staked strangers build real identity score. An attacker must rent independent, reputable agents, paying fees and burning collateral per fake identity, so a sybil ring costs more than honest participation earns. Like a lagoon shielding calm water from open ocean, this boundary isolates clusters; even a sonnet signed by a hundred fake poets reads as noise, not proof.
